transport.GET: Same-origin requests; no CSRF header required.

POST.Origin: Exactly APP_ORIGIN; browsers set this automatically.
POST.X-CSRF-Token: Session csrfToken; login is the only exception.
POST.Idempotency-Key: 16–128 characters matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]; use crypto.randomUUID(). Keep the same key and identical body on retries.

transport.cookies: Same-origin credentials. Opaque __Host-pisteborssi cookie, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, expires in 365 days. Password change rotates it and revokes every old session for that person.
transport.cache: All responses no-store; no CORS grant.

state.people: [{id,name,role,archived,username?}] — username exists only for cloud accounts. No credential/email fields.
state.entries: Array<PointEntry|RewardEntry>; original imported IDs, timestamps, revisions and soft-deletion fields preserved.
state.rules: Array<FamilyRule> in creation order, including soft-deleted history. Older V4 stored states without rules normalize to []. No password data.

GET session.note: Unauthenticated returns no ledger. Valid requests automatically initialize ONLY the five fixed FAMILY accounts if DB is empty and server-only INITIAL_USER_PASSWORD is configured. Missing/invalid setup secret on an empty DB returns503 initialization_required with safe deployment instructions. Initialized DB works without the setup secret.

POST login.note: Generic401 for wrong user/password. Database-backed username/IP throttle429. Forced password change indicated by user.mustChange.

POST person.note: Either active parent may create role child or parent after changing their own initial password. Atomic person+account creation; unique normalized username, individually salted temporary password (5–256 characters), mustChange=true. Same key/body retries create only one account.

POST archive.note: Toggles archived. Archiving self clears cookie and returns user:null,csrfToken:null. Last active login-capable parent cannot be archived.

POST credentials.note: Either parent may create an account for an active profile without one. Temporary password 5–256 characters, mustChange=true. Existing cloud account always409; never resets credentials.

POST password.note: Every authenticated user can change only their own password. Save fresh csrfToken. Clear mustChange; invalidate all old sessions. A lost response is recoverable with the original cookie, original CSRF, identical body and original idempotency key while the newly issued session remains active.

POST import-preview.note: Accepts versions1–4, ignores ALL local credential/username/email values. Preview persists in DB, bound to actor and sanitized source hash/revision, expires in30min. Existing accounts unchanged. Show summary, conflicts and explicit confirmation. Rule IDs dedupe if identical, any differing rule ID blocks the entire commit. A missing/empty rule array in old backups never deletes existing rules; incoming rules append in their source order.

POST import-commit.note: Merge only; dedupe identical IDs. ANY conflicting ID blocks whole commit409. Rechecks authoritative ledger on CAS retry. Unknown people retain their IDs but have no accounts; use credentials later. Already consumed preview409 unless retry uses same idempotency key. Rule IDs dedupe if identical, any differing rule ID blocks the entire commit. A missing/empty rule array in old backups never deletes existing rules; incoming rules append in their source order.

POST rule-create.note: Active parent with mustChange=false only. Server assigns stable ID and actor/timestamps. Plain text title 1–120 and content 1–4000 characters; both nonblank. At most 100 rules including deleted history.

POST rule-edit.note: Same parent guard. Preserves position, ID and creation fields; appends previous title/content to bounded history (100 edits). Only active rules.

POST rule-delete.note: Same parent guard. Soft deletion with server timestamp/actor; all prior content, revisions and point history remain. UI renumbers active rules 1§, 2§ etc.

POST password-reset.note: Active parent whose mustChange=false, reauthenticated using their own currentPassword. Only ANOTHER active profile with an existing account (child or parent). New temporary password 12–256 characters, <=1024 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank. Individually salted hashTemporaryPassword, mustChange=true. One account delta and p_revoke_actor=target revoke all target sessions transactionally; no new target session issued; parent and other sessions unchanged. No plaintext/password/hash echo. Database throttle 5 attempts/15min per parent across sessions, including wrong reauthentication; successful same-key replay does not increment reset bucket. CAS detects a concurrent target credential change with 409 password_reset_conflict, never overwrites it silently.

rules.negative: topic=other and nonempty reason required; Other always needs a reason, even for positive points. Reason max300; other topics have empty reason.
rules.reward: Parent-only. Current balance>=10. One reward entry with points=-10,amount=5.
rules.authorization: All authenticated active users see all sanitized state. Children point-write own childId only. Parent-only reward/edit/delete/person/archive/credentials/password-reset/rule-create/rule-edit/rule-delete/import-preview/import-commit/backup. mustChange blocks every POST except password/logout.
rules.password: New personal passwords:12–256 characters, at most1024 UTF-8 bytes. Temporary initial passwords:5–256 characters, at most1024 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank; hashTemporaryPassword always sets mustChange=true. All POSTs except password/logout blocked until password change. Individually salted scrypt N32768,r8,p3; no passwords/hashes ever returned to browser. Parent reset temporary passwords require at least 12 characters (the legacy five-character initial account password policy is unchanged). Forgotten own password requires another parent; loss of all parent access is owner-assisted recovery only, with no unauthenticated bypass.
rules.username: Normalized trim/lowercase. 3–40 ASCII letters/numbers/dot/underscore/hyphen, begins with letter or number. Public username is not a password.
rules.retries: Committed keys are retained indefinitely. Same actor+key+operation/body replays immutable operation metadata with CURRENT sanitized state; different payload409. Cache records never duplicate the full ledger. Auth/active roles are rechecked.
rules.availability: Never substitute localStorage or local authentication on503. Show the real configuration/network error and retry the same idempotency key for potentially committed writes.
rules.familyRules: All active authenticated family members may read. Initially no real rules are seeded. Native collapsed plain-text accordions in scores and separate rules view; parent CRUD, stable creation order and soft-deletion audit. UI preserves expansion and unsaved editor fields during polling.

deployment: First install only: sql/setup.sql. Existing grounded production: run ONLY sql/2026-10-04-family-rules.sql as the existing function owner BEFORE application deployment, then sql/check-family-rules.sql (read-only synthetic JSON validation). Migration replaces only pb_validate_state, guarded by exact active-definition MD5, with same owner/ACL/security/search_path. Unexpected drift aborts; exact repeat is a no-op. Never reset data, rerun setup or relax RLS/grants.
Configure server-only SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY,APP_ORIGIN,RATE_LIMIT_SECRET. Use sb_secret_ via apikey ONLY, never Bearer.

No local Node installation or bootstrap required. Set INITIAL_USER_PASSWORD as a Vercel Production server-only secret, Redeploy, then open the app. Five fixed usernames ilkka/hanna/elli/aava/stella with roles parent/parent/child/child/child are initialized atomically by existing pb_initialize. Each must change their own password. Remove setup secret and Redeploy after initialization.

Existing ledger/accounts/passwords are NEVER reset or backfilled by redeploy/setup secret changes. pb_initialize advisory transaction lock prevents competing server instances from duplicating setup. No public init operation accepts arbitrary users/passwords.

Optional advanced LOCAL bootstrap remains compatible: node --env-file=.env scripts/bootstrap.mjs; five independent hidden 12–256 character password prompts. Refuses any already initialized DB before prompting.
Node22.x required by package.json; no dependencies or production in-memory persistence.
Mock tests do not validate a live PostgreSQL/Supabase deployment. SQL and deployment still require real integration verification.

Committed idempotency snapshots retained indefinitely for payout safety; monitor Supabase storage. Ledger limits:200people,20000entries,2MiB serialized ledger,100edits per entry and per rule,100rules including deleted history; request body2MiB.
